description: Update an invoice: mark it paid (records paid_at; a receipted ledger event with the actor, invoice id, number, amount and the before/after status is written first, and nothing changes if it cannot be), overdue, cancelled, or edit client details / notes / due date. A paid invoice is final: any further change is refused 409 invoice_paid_locked (no refunds, edits or deletes).

paid_at.description: ISO timestamp (default now) when status = paid

name: tascan_update_invoice
